title: Joining Further Paid TRICARE Select Inpatient Lines to an Allowable Charge Review — Appeals and Grievances Desk Guide
content:
Appeals and Grievances desk guide — further paid TRICARE Select inpatient lines joining an Allowable Charge Review

**Rule.** A further paid TRICARE Select inpatient line of a claim joins the Allowable Charge Review already filed on that claim for the same allowed-amount dispute, keeping its own line reference.

**Prerequisite.** The amount recorded for a further paid line joining an Allowable Charge Review is not fixed until an Allowable Charge Review stands filed on an earlier paid line of the same claim.

**Subject.** A paid line joining an Allowable Charge Review is recorded with the claim line itself as its subject, an allowable charge being the kind of subject that review hears.

**Timeliness.** A line joins in time when the day its record is received is no later than the joining line's posted date plus the review's filing deadline in calendar days, counted from the day after that posted date, a record received on the last of those days being in time. Hypothetical: a joining line posted on day P, with the Allowable Charge Review filing deadline of N calendar days, joins in time on day P plus N and not on the day after; the count runs from the joining line's own posted date.

### Invocation: `join_line_charge_review_4bed256c`

**Capability.** The appellant joins, in their own name, a further paid line of a TRICARE Select claim to the Allowable Charge Review already open on that claim for the same allowed-amount dispute. One call records the joining line as its own review record keeping its own line reference: it is recorded as received today on the standard review track with status filed, under the same claim number, with the line's own determination date, who is filing and the amount in dispute given (the amount the review carries once this line has joined it); no appointment of representative is marked as on file. The appellant can follow the joined line with the rest of the review on the beneficiary web portal and through customer service.

**Invocation and owner.** A customer-run tool: the agent unlocks `join_line_charge_review_4bed256c` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | the beneficiary reference number of the patient the claim line belongs to, as returned by the beneficiary profile lookup (an identifier) | identifier |
| `subject_claim_line_id` | the reference number of the paid TRICARE Select claim line that joins the open review, as returned by the Select claim line lookup | identifier |
| `subject_referral_authorization_id` | a denied authorization the case is about; a review of an allowed amount concerns no authorization, so the empty string "" is passed (the authorization lookup returns no reference for it) | the empty string "" |
| `subject_enrollment_id` | an enrollment ended for nonpayment the case is about; a review of an allowed amount concerns no enrollment, so the empty string "" is passed (the enrollment lookup returns no reference for it) | the empty string "" |
| `subject_claim_number` | the claim number of that line as printed on the Explanation of Benefits and shown on the claim line record returned by the Select claim line lookup | verbatim: copied character for character with its letters, digits and hyphens, with no normalisation, addition or deletion |
| `initial_determination_date` | the date of the determination on the joining line | YYYY-MM-DD (calendar date, no time or time zone) |
| `filed_by` | who is filing, one of: `beneficiary` (the patient files their own case); `parent_or_guardian` (a parent or legal guardian files for a minor or incapacitated patient); `appointed_representative` (a person the patient has appointed files on the patient's behalf); `participating_provider` (a participating provider files on its own claim) | one of the four values listed |
| `amount_in_dispute` | the amount in dispute recorded on the joining line in USD, 2 decimal places (cents), a non-negative number, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed | USD, 2 decimals, non-negative, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** "Claim line [line] joined to the Allowable Charge Review on claim [claim number] as record [record id]: status filed, received [YYYY-MM-DD], amount in dispute [amount] USD." — the received date is today's date and the amount is the booked amount with two decimals. The presence of the record reference number indicates that the line was joined.
